items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: What “The Sting” did for Scott Joplin and Ragtime was fantastic.

ctx.x: Well you looked darned good in “The Aviator.”

Oh thanks. Well that was a lot of fun. Films are one way of turning people around. And with all these films that I’ve been associated with in the past twenty years or so I was always looking for another Sting movie. What “The Sting” did for Scott Joplin and Ragtime was fantastic. It took this music that really was in the background and young kids were learning “The Sting” which is really “The Entertainer.” And we were always hoping for a successful film that would get kids interested in early jazz and some of…
Well did we get you on your soapbox enough today?
